text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the train ride home after the race—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, want to take a little detour? 
Look, the sunset is so pretty, too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Look, the town is dyed in red. And what's 
more—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Found it, found it! Look, in that tree. 
Can you see the bird's nest?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
When I came here a few weeks ago, there 
were still chicks... I guess they've 
already left the nest.
choice_data_list:
I wish we could've gotten here a bit 
earlier.

It would've been nice if we could've 
gotten here a bit earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—I love racing. Because out there is where 
I can be most myself.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, doing only that... leaves me out of 
breath.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So, every now and then I stop in my 
tracks... and catch my breath, watching 
nature at work and the setting sun.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
This is my pace. Since you and I are gonna 
be together for a long time yet, I'd like 
you to remember it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With all these back-to-back races, she 
hasn't been able to find time for 
herself... Deeply regretting this, I swore 
to adjust her schedule.
